facts.text: The clone is a Princeton Instruments / Acton 2300i spectrometer plug-in that uses the RS-232 or USB-serial interface and was tested with Acton 2300i and 300 series spectrometers
The serial interface opens the port at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity and one stop bit with a 5.0 s timeout
A command is written as ASCII followed by CR (\r)
A reply is accepted only when it ends with ' ok\r\n'
read_done_status sends MONO-?DONE and returns the reply as a boolean
read_wl sends ?NM and parses the first token of the reply as a float in nm
write_wl sends '<wavelength> NM', write_wl_fast sends '<wavelength> GOTO' and write_wl_nonblock sends '<wavelength> >NM', each with three decimals

read_grating_info sends ?GRATINGS and parses one (number, name) line per grating; read_grating sends ?GRATING and returns the current number; read_grating_name returns the entry of the current grating
write_grating requires 0 < grating < 10 and sends '<grating> GRATING'
read_turret sends ?TURRET and returns an integer; write_turret only asserts a turret of 1, 2 or 3 and sends no command
read_exit_mirror sends 'EXIT-MIRROR ?MIRROR'; write_exit_mirror accepts FRONT or SIDE and sends 'EXIT-MIRROR <pos>'
read_entrance_slit sends 'SIDE-ENT-SLIT ?MICRONS', reports -1 for 'no motor' or 'no slit'; write_entrance_slit accepts 5 to 3000 um and sends 'SIDE-ENT-SLIT <n> MICRONS'
read_exit_slit sends 'SIDE-EXIT-SLIT ?MICRONS', reports -1 for 'no motor' or 'no slit'; write_exit_slit accepts 5 to 3000 um and sends 'SIDE-EXIT-SLIT <n> MICRONS'
home_entrance_slit is a TODO that only holds the string 'SIDE-ENT-SLIT SHOME' and sends no command

The ScopeFoundry component connects center_wl to read_wl/write_wl_fast, grating_id to read_grating/write_grating, grating_name to read_grating_name, entrance_slit and exit_slit to their read/write methods and exit_mirror to read_exit_mirror/write_exit_mirror
The ScopeFoundry component declares center_wl in nm with vmin=-100 and vmax=2000 (a setting range, not a stated instrument range)

The HardwareComponent computes a per-pixel wavelength calibration in get_wl_calibration/wl_p_calib from the grating_calibrations setting; it is a pure calculation on the component, not a method of the serial interface

operator_required.reason: no text of the clone states the wavelength range of a spectrometer; the only wavelength range in the clone is the ScopeFoundry center_wl setting vmin=-100 vmax=2000 (acton_spec.py:37), a component default rather than an instrument specification, so the site supplies the nm range of its unit

safe_state.description: serial link closed (close()); no further motion, grating or slit command is sent, and a move already executing in the instrument is not halted
